up: Retrieve exact activity measurements (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4649958'. Output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound_name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), assay_chembl_id (assays.chembl_id), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value. Do not add limits or extra filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649958' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
